```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(knitr)
```

Page 1
======================================================================

### Section 1

```{r}
summary(mtcars)
```

### Section 2

```{r}
plot(mtcars$mpg, mtcars$hp, main="MPG vs HP", xlab="Miles per Gallon", ylab="Horsepower")
```

Page 2
======================================================================

### Analyse des données

```{r}
cor(mtcars)
```

### Visualisation

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
```
